label: Preserve established PostgreSQL types in the matching contract

precheck.description: The service-area migration must be applied first
precheck.sql: SELECT to_regclass('public.driver_matching_stats') IS NOT NULL AND to_regclass('public.driver_availability') IS NOT NULL AND to_regclass('public.recurring_runs') IS NOT NULL AND to_regclass('public.run_assignments') IS NOT NULL AND to_regclass('public.driver_schedule_slots') IS NOT NULL AS result

execute.description: Align columns without discarding existing time values

postcheck.description: Confirm all matching columns use the contract types
postcheck.sql: SELECT (SELECT udt_name FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='public' AND table_name='driver_matching_stats' AND column_name='operating_day')='int2' AND (SELECT udt_name FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='public' AND table_name='driver_matching_stats' AND column_name='typical_departure_time')='time' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='public' AND table_name IN ('driver_schedule_slots','driver_availability','recurring_runs','run_assignments') AND column_name='leg_type' AND udt_name<>'ScheduleLegType') AS result
